data_fields.name: ammo_box_weight
data_fields.donor_constant: proto item.weight of the ammo box

best_idea: Give an item a hidden flag so it weighs nothing, stays out of the loot list, and is removed on death; and check both sides of a two-sided trade (carry on each side, then value) before any item moves.
decision_why: Keep the hidden flag and the two-sided check, but drop the donor's temporary box and make the death removal a server ledger event with a receipt; the loot view is a filter over the one ledger.
acceptance: A hidden item does not appear in the corpse loot payload and does not change the carry total shown on the phone; a server test asserts that after a death event no ledger row for a hidden item remains, and that a barter refused for one side changes no row on either side.
